home.eyebrow: Salon, spa and grooming at home
home.title: Experience Luxury Salon Care,
home.subtitle: Relax and rejuvenate with our certified beauty experts — premium salon, spa and grooming services delivered to your doorstep.
home.promise: A verified professional at your door in {{min}}–{{max}} minutes

steps.oneBody: See the full price before you pay. Taxes are included and nothing is added at your door.
steps.twoBody: A free, verified professional near you accepts within seconds. If no one is free, your money comes back automatically.
steps.threeBody: Follow them on the map. The service starts only when you share your 4-digit OTP.

trust.verifiedBody: We check every professional's identity and work before their first booking.
trust.otpBody: The service begins when you share a 4-digit code at the door, so you always know who you let in.
trust.priceBody: Prices include taxes. The total you see before paying is the total you pay.

faq.a1: Usually within {{min}}–{{max}} minutes of paying, depending on traffic and how many professionals are free near you. You see their live location and a time estimate.
faq.q2: What if no professional is free?
faq.a2: We keep looking for {{searchMinutes}} minutes. If no one accepts, you get a full refund automatically, to the same way you paid.
faq.q3: Do I pay before the service?
faq.a3: Yes, you pay online when you book. The price you see before paying is final: taxes are included and there are no extra charges at your door.
faq.q4: Can I ask for a female professional?
faq.a4: Yes. At checkout you can ask for a female or male professional, or choose no preference to get someone faster.
faq.a5: Everything your service needs: products, tools and disposable sheets. Please keep a clean space and a power socket ready.

home.ctaBody: Pick a service and a professional can be on the way in minutes.

about.title: About us
about.lead: We bring salon, spa and grooming services to your home in minutes, done by verified professionals, at prices you see before you pay.
about.whatBody: Book a service and the nearest free professional accepts within seconds and comes to you. You follow them on a live map, and the service starts only when you share your OTP.
about.prosBody: Every professional applies with their identity documents and work experience. We check both before their first booking, and we watch ratings and feedback after every job.
about.promiseBody: One clear price with taxes included, no charges at your door, and your money back automatically if no one is free.
about.joinBody: Join us to get bookings near you, on your own hours.

join.title: Join as a professional
join.lead: Get bookings near you, on your own hours. You choose when you're online; we send you nearby jobs and pay you for every one you complete.

steps.applyBody: Fill in the application form with your skills, experience and identity documents.
steps.verifyBody: Our team checks your documents and work. This usually takes a few working days.
steps.passwordBody: Once approved, you get an email with a link to set your password.
steps.onlineTitle: Install the app and go online
steps.onlineBody: Add the professional app to your phone's home screen, allow alerts and location, and tap Online to start getting jobs.
